extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: Mrs. Dubois was presented with a Mutual of Omaha plan with a $25 monthly premium, $315 drug deductible, and $6600 maximum out-of-pocket. The agent collected a Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review for 3 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Luis, you mentioned 'lowest premium' without substantiating it. Consider providing more context or evidence to support this claim.
